digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter extraction and characterization testing
propositions: Exact-value characterization tests must pin the current output of every unit being extracted from adapters/jira/ to prevent silent mapping changes during the move.
The existing contract test suite is backend-agnostic by design and cannot detect Jira-specific mapping regressions, so dedicated characterization oracles are required.
Value map defaults (To Do for status, Medium for priority) and boundary conditions (sanitizer limits at 254-vs-255 bytes, label rejection reasons) must each be pinned by individual test assertions.
The legacy rebar-id- hyphen identity format must be preserved and tested alongside the current colon form to ensure backward compatibility during extraction.
